title: Knotted Flaky Polish Pierogi Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish with a twist, featuring green curry paste for a bitter flavor, and a flaky texture, perfect for meal prep and low fat diets. This recipe is a unique take on the classic pierogi.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, green curry paste, and salt, and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sour cream and egg until smooth.
Add the water to the sour cream mixture and whisk until emulsified.
Add the grated potato and chopped onion to the sour cream mixture and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into smaller pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the potato and onion mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a knot and press the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pierogi for about 5 minutes, until they float to the surface.
Remove the pierogi from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
